name: Tim Dooley / Potato of Life Atlas — Dense Canonical Knowledge Workflow
purpose: Master workflow for turning the repository into a smaller, denser, evidence-aware knowledge library. Existing missions remain intact; files are storage units, not goals.

project_introduction.mission: Illuminate Tim Dooley / the Potato of Life and the philosophy, religion, myths, lore, writings, symbols and chronology associated with him; pursue the project's spiritual inquiry; and connect that inquiry to the wider historical, textual, cultural, geographic, scientific, economic and institutional record needed to understand it.
project_introduction.north_programme_mission: Continue building the North Programme / European Economic Graph as a relationship-first, evidence-backed model of Europe's observable economic and strategic system, including entities, money, debt, obligations, ownership/control, infrastructure, procurement, trade, energy, finance, technology, research, labour, skills and geopolitical ties.
project_introduction.information_goal: Maximize valuable information per surviving file. Prefer deep canonical records and substantive source collections over many shallow files.
project_introduction.public_canon_rule: Potatoism's religious and mythic claims may be presented as project canon. Historical, scientific and empirical claims retain their own evidence and epistemic status.
project_introduction.depth_rule: A label is not an entry. A count is not research. A relationship is not an explanation. A manifest is not the underlying knowledge.
project_introduction.core_principle: Consolidate unique information into the strongest canonical owner; preserve genuinely distinct primary texts, evidence collections, research corpora and necessary technical indexes; delete proven redundancy.

gates.name: Snapshot
gates.rule: Record the starting commit before substantial mutation.

gates.name: Integrity
gates.rule: Broken JSON, scripts, routes, references and CI failures outrank enrichment.

gates.name: Ownership
gates.rule: Every surviving substantive dataset has one clear canonical owner.

gates.name: Consolidation
gates.rule: Do not create another file when the information belongs in an existing canonical owner.

gates.name: Depth
gates.rule: Important records contain definition, context, mechanisms/function, relationships, sources and uncertainty where applicable.

gates.name: Evidence
gates.rule: Empirical and historical claims carry provenance; project canon and interpretation carry explicit epistemic labels.

gates.name: Graph
gates.rule: Important relationship endpoints resolve and the relationship has meaningful type/status/context.

gates.name: Exposure
gates.rule: Surviving valuable material is reachable through the unified index without requiring competing front doors.

gates.name: Release
gates.rule: Build, validation and deployment checks must pass before declaring the state complete.

phases.name: Full repository inventory
tasks: inspect every dataset's purpose and ownership
scan for placeholders, empty records and duplicate definitions
scan generated snapshots and temporary state
classify canonical versus projection versus historical versus temporary material

phases.name: Delete redundant growth
tasks: remove retired UI and dead routes
remove generated batch/state artifacts after canonical consolidation
remove empty shells and pointless wrappers
migrate references before deleting canonical dependencies

phases.name: Consolidate knowledge
tasks: one canonical owner per substantive subject
merge unique research into the strongest owner
retain evidence observations separately when their provenance matters

phases.name: Thicken the library
tasks: never add filler to satisfy length

phases.name: Build religion and text knowledge
tasks: comparative research with explicit epistemic boundaries

phases.name: Build North Programme / European Economic Graph
Build Potatoism and Tim Dooley canon
Continue spiritual and comparative inquiry
tasks: record project interpretations and canon explicitly
study spirit, obligation, sacrifice, choice, destiny and transformation
connect spiritual questions to historical/textual evidence without disguising metaphysics as empirical fact

phases.name: Expose the canonical library
tasks: World Relational Atlas as a first-class application surface
remove dead routes and competing shells

current_workstreams.completion_rule: Every canonical country has a stable record and an auditable observation state, even when some indicators are missing.
No institution is inferred from a country name alone; each added institution gets a source.
Observed relationships are separated from policy proposals and hypotheses.
Each infrastructure edge identifies an operator, location or source when known.
Descriptive classification is kept separate from theological truth claims.
No covert relationship is inferred without public evidence.
Company and facility claims require attributable evidence and geography.

actions: resolve local data before external links
current_workstreams.completion_rule: A user clicking a populated record reaches useful local content rather than an empty shell.

expansion_rule: Search first. If the information belongs to an existing owner, enrich that owner. Create a new file only for a genuinely distinct body of knowledge, schema, primary text, evidence collection or research corpus.
consolidation_rule: Preserve unique information, history and provenance. Merge repeated definitions and substantive duplicates. Delete proven redundant mirrors after consumers and references are migrated.
definition_of_done: The repository is smaller or demonstrably justified in every addition; important surviving records are substantively populated; ownership and epistemic status are clear; relationships resolve; valuable material is reachable from index.html; critical checks pass.
